coalescence.exact: Previous normalized full content; SHA candidate then actual content equality
coalescence.future: Exclude only below nondecision statistics; preserve all other fields; sort heap logical entries, preserve actual serial values and counter; retain stale entries
coalescence.exclusions_justification: These are recorded statistics, not action/score/queue decision inputs in frozen step; external consumed resource costs and budget remainder reported separately. No claim of equal remaining wall time or remaining bounded budget.
coalescence.scope: All saved complete A/B checkpoints, including cross-depth pairs; initial (0,0) excluded; no match means only no observed coalescence

decision_rules.repeat: Actual complete content equality in common prefix. Wall-only length differences are censored, not automatic errors.
decision_rules.legacy_suffix: A and A_repeat new steps 109/110 and B_repeat109 match saved old suffix exactly; count these as formal continuation, no extra preflight forwards
decision_rules.score_consistency: Audit observed values only; never provides cross-branch values; same key bytes mismatch stops related event
decision_rules.window: A/B analysis uses all-four common complete observed prefix; longer nonrepeated tails are explicitly descriptive
decision_rules.complete: For e newly completed steps: E=108+e and task total=110+e. delta_E=E_B-E_A; delta_L=full legal plan length B minus A. Four legal solutions and terminal repeats required for confirmed full event effect
decision_rules.terminal_repeat: Main branches solved but repeat censored => TERMINAL_REPEAT_INCOMPLETE; descriptive outcome only
decision_rules.plan: Original task action contract replay; legal is not optimal; no distance certification
decision_rules.incomplete: Only complete expansion boundary is authoritative; separately save partial where/how stopped; interrupted calls are actual resource costs but not valid score samples
decision_rules.timing: Load/restore/final save separate. Search wall includes all loop logging/checkpoint costs. No further search at first cap, no restart or fifth slot
decision_rules.accounts: Logical path excludes rolled-back old suffix; research resources preserve old completed and interrupted spend plus every new worker/auxiliary expense
decision_rules.threshold: No new posthoc magnitude threshold. Report delta_E and delta_L separately without a winner fusion

logging.physical_heap: Full exact heap physical array each delta; analysis can sort only under prior future-scene rule
logging.delta: CLOSED/node/score_cache add-delete-update; all remaining scene fields exact add-delete-update; before and after canonical hashes verified
logging.space_guard: Count existing branch files and pending encoded sequence bytes; reserve for final and partial saves, independent physical free space guard; stop on cap, never drop adverse logs
logging.reconstruction: Every committed complete scene reconstructs losslessly from initial108 + chained deltas
